conf.description: VTC Systems, call-signaling, syslog-kv: parses the Expressway/VCS tvcs name=value event log into ECS. event.outcome derived from Event/Response-code/Auth; SIP/H.323 aliases split into user+domain; TLS normalized to transport=tcp plus a separate encrypted flag; call-correlation keys kept custom (ECS has no call id).

conf.comment: Expressway/VCS call-signaling event log (tvcs). No integration or pack exists for this format; hand-built against the documented name=value elements. KVP field names are vendor-hyphenated (Src-ip, Response-code, ...) which the platform's rename/remove property-accessor builder rejects, so those are read via bracket-notation in eval and cleaned up with code, not rename/remove. Detail is kept as the sole 'message' source per the recommendation (do not also duplicate it from _raw).

functions.description: Message body: a Cribl Syslog Source leaves the full line, header included, in _raw and the body in message; anything else carries the body in _raw.
Extract the tvcs name=value pairs from _raw
Derive ECS/custom fields (bracket-read hyphenated vendor names); remove plain-identifier originals

conf.code: delete __e['Src-ip']; delete __e['Src-port']; delete __e['Dst-ip']; delete __e['Dst-port']; delete __e['Src-alias']; delete __e['Dst-alias']; delete __e['Call-serial-number']; delete __e['Call-id']; delete __e['Response-code']; delete __e['Num-bytes'];

functions.description: Remove hyphenated vendor originals - rename/eval.remove reject hyphenated property paths
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
